subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support ~/.volta/bin/node as a managed macOS LaunchAgent fallback when process.execPath is ~/.volta/tools/image/node/<version>/bin/node and no supported system/Homebrew Node is available?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but it changes daemon runtime policy from warning about version-manager paths toward supporting a specific Volta shim fallback under launchd.

options.title: Require Proof-Backed Volta Fallback
options.body: Keep this issue open and accept a refreshed Volta helper change only with focused tests plus redacted live LaunchAgent install/reinstall proof under Volta.

options.title: Prefer Broader Runtime Policy
options.body: Defer the Volta-specific fallback behind the bundled-Node or explicit runtime-pin work so OpenClaw has one daemon runtime contract.

options.title: Reject Version-Manager Service Fallbacks
options.body: Document system or OpenClaw-managed Node as the supported managed-service path and close this issue after that maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Require Proof-Backed Volta Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and accept a refreshed Volta helper change only with focused tests plus redacted live LaunchAgent install/reinstall proof under Volta.

likelyOwner.reason: The current system-Node preference and fallback behavior route through steipete's runtime-selection history.
